G1_unambiguity.justification: The assignment, risk calculation, collaborative-load table, equality condition, and lexicographic tie-break are all precisely defined.

G2_completeness.justification: It specifies the input bounds and format, agency labels, validity condition, output format, tie-break rule, and relevant edge cases such as zero ventures.

G3_faithfulness.justification: For each joint venture, the risk contribution equals its listed load exactly when the endpoint agencies differ, while every equal-agency pair contributes an excess of 8, so the equality condition is equivalent to proper three-coloring and preserves the original outputs and bounds.

G4_naturalness.justification: The corporate-audit framing is coherent and idiomatic, although the elaborate regulatory metric and lookup table feel deliberately constructed to encode the original coloring condition.
